public_rationale: Contemporary reporting gives substantial directional support: the two developers Zitron names were described as losing money. But the records found do not establish comparable realized losses across the relevant businesses in the target period. Their full-year forecasts cannot by themselves settle the broader current observation.
limitations: This does not establish that generative AI was profitable.
A narrower assessment restricted to the existence of loss forecasts for OpenAI and Anthropic would be easier to support.
Available financial definitions and company coverage differ.

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that businesses developing and supplying generative AI were sustaining substantial losses. It does not require every application or infrastructure supplier to lose money.
The surrounding examples identify OpenAI and Anthropic as important evidence, but do not define them as the entire sector.

For this ongoing financial observation, I use January–September 2024, the latest completed year-to-date financial reporting period before publication. The surrounding full-year forecasts are relevant context, not realized results for this period.
I interpret 'incredibly' as losses substantial relative to revenue, without inventing a numerical cutoff.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable financial evidence establishes substantial losses relative to revenue across the principal generative AI developers and providers during the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes that the principal generative AI developers and providers were broadly profitable or incurred only modest losses during the target period.
